review.reviewer: root (independent dependency review; approval sent in task coordination)
review.decision: Conditionally approved for one private, fixed-symbol Windows host bridge; no generic FFI surface.

dependency.name: ffi-rs
dependency.consumerBinary: The published ffi-rs@1.3.7 npm metadata declares the optional @yuuang/ffi-rs-win32-x64-msvc@1.3.7 package. The current GitHub master/package.json instead lists 1.0.55; this source-vs-registry discrepancy was checked and the lockfile follows the published npm metadata at 1.3.7.
dependency.rustMsrv: No MSRV is declared in upstream Cargo.toml. The application consumes the published optional MSVC binary and does not compile the dependency from Rust source; upstream source uses Rust edition 2021.

packageChanges: pnpm-lock.yaml resolution and Windows x64 optional sidecar
typesAndLifetime: Win32 BOOL values use I32; process/window/thread IDs use U32.
HANDLE values use ffi-rs External pointers; handles from OpenProcess are closed in finally.
Each FILETIME buffer is allocated and restored as ffi-rs DataType.BigInt (64-bit), then serialized as a decimal string; no Number conversion of process-creation identity values.
GetClipboardSequenceNumber returning zero is unavailable/fail-closed; the baseline is sampled at selection time before content preparation.
buildAndPackaging: No new custom native build script or project Cargo toolchain is introduced.

The exact dependency and lockfile are the only package-manager changes; pnpm-lock.yaml resolves the registry-published win32-x64-msvc optional sidecar at 1.3.7, despite the current GitHub master package.json showing 1.0.55.
Electron remains pinned at 40.10.2; T03/T05 must smoke-test the addon under Electron 40 and packaged Windows x64 output.
Do not update Electron as part of this subcard.

forbidden: No renderer imports or IPC-configurable DLL path, library handle, symbol name, function signature, raw pointer, or arbitrary FFI dispatch.
No environment-derived SystemRoot path, arbitrary relative path, UNC path, drive path, or traversal path; bridge opens only the allowlisted kernel32.dll and user32.dll KnownDLL basenames.
No PowerShell, helper self-authorization, or success-only stub in place of the Win32 calls.
runtimeRisks: ffi-rs N-API compatibility does not remove the need to verify its optional MSVC binary loads in Electron 40.10.2.
Electron 40 is EOL per the independent review; this remains a known runtime risk and is not permission to upgrade Electron here.

The bridge calls are synchronous and must remain limited to bounded identity/foreground/clipboard-sequence APIs; image decoding must enforce compressed-byte and output-size bounds and run off the Electron main event loop.
notEvidenceOf: No actual AllowSetForegroundWindow invocation has been observed yet.
No helper launch, target activation, clipboard access/write, keyboard input, or packaged Windows smoke is claimed by this subcard.
